changelog:
Initial release of arkit-visionos-developer

- Guides setup and management of ARKitSession for visionOS.
- Explains handling of provider-specific authorization and privacy.
- Details usage and configuration of ARKit data providers (world tracking, hand tracking, plane detection, scene reconstruction, etc.).
- Provides best practices for bridging ARKit anchor data into RealityKit entities.
- Covers session lifecycle management and common pitfalls.
- Includes quick start steps, implementation patterns, and reference tables for providers.
